title: check-empty-files.sh checks the size of the working-tree file instead of the staged content, silently passes when run from a subfolder, and is not installed as a hook

evidence.note: staged paths come from git diff --cached --name-only (repo-root relative)
[ -f "$f" ] and wc -c on the working-tree file, resolved from the current folder: a staged empty blob with a non-empty working copy passes, and from a subfolder every path is skipped
install is a manual per-clone step; nothing in the repo installs or runs it (no npm script, no CI step)

sibling_sites_checked: package.json scripts (:7-18) and .github/workflows/test.yml: neither runs it. The tracked 0-byte file at the base is reports/.gitkeep (allow-listed); .DS_Store is 6148 bytes (AUD-ROOT-005).
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: a guard that does not guard; no capital path.
recommendation: Phase 25 (cleanup) or Phase 31 (CI gates): check the staged blob size (git cat-file -s :<path>), cd to the repo root first, and run it as a CI step if it is kept.
